title: WWT ↔ U.S. Army Signal Mapping
description: World Wide Technology public content and Army business, set next to U.S. Army leadership priorities.
readFirst: Covers Nov. 9–17. A St. Louis Business Journal headline dated Nov. 16 said World Wide Technology reaffirmed its Nvidia partnership after Jensen Huang's resignation, but the article body was behind a paywall and was not used. No WWT newsroom release dated Nov. 16–17 was found. The mapping subsection is empty.
